title: Restore green CI on develop: daemon fallback, Virtuus pin, lint and spec fixes
description:
As a Kanbus maintainer, I want develop CI green again, so that blocked PRs #388 and #387 can be reviewed and merged.

Root causes on the latest run over develop (PR #379 run, plus current tip):
- rust: console_lambda tests panic with 'Virtuus daemon request failed: No such file or directory'. The daemon is just-in-time and optional; connect or request failure must fall back to synchronous in-process storage instead of failing. Direction from Ryan: never require the daemon for correctness.
- python: ruff F401 unused import in issue_listing.py.
- python and python-console-parity: issue_compaction.feature:45 archived-issue summarize scenario asserts a summary comment that was not written.
- python-install (windows-latest): virtuus 0.5.1 references socketserver.ThreadingUnixStreamServer at import time, which does not exist on Windows; pin Virtuus v0.6.0 which adds virtuus.service Windows-safe import.
- router-state timing test flakiness to be made deterministic if it reproduces.

Reconcile with PR #385 (claude/salvage-release-fixes): take its Virtuus pin and any still-valid fixes, but implement daemon fallback in product code rather than bypassing the daemon via KANBUS_NO_DAEMON=1 in tests, per Ryan's direction.

Specs first: (a) with no daemon available, commands succeed synchronously; (b) with the daemon available, it is used.
